description: Frostfire Leggings Level 60 Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Leggings if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Leggings, 20 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Leggings - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 20 - Mooncloth x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Frostfire Leggings
